justification: Inspected ui/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/ui/report/ReportStage.java, AbstractReportRowBean.java, ReportPackageFilter.java, IReportRowBean.java, ReportStageType.java, plus consumers ui/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/ui/main/JITWatchUI.java and ui/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/ui/stage/StageManager.java. ReportStage has broad fan-out: it imports/uses org.adoptopenjdk.jitwatch.core, org.adoptopenjdk.jitwatch.report, org.adoptopenjdk.jitwatch.ui.main, org.adoptopenjdk.jitwatch.util, javafx, and four ui.report subpackages/cell helpers (suggestion, eliminatedallocation, locks, inlining, cell), while only 7 packages in the repo import exact-package types (ui.main, ui.stage, ui.report.cell, and the four ui.report subpackages). The package therefore has more outgoing than incoming coupling and depends on several low-fan-in report subpackages, which is consistent with Unstable Dependency.
